title: Sword and death among the four scourges
english: After famine and wild beasts come [[sword and death >> Bible:Ezekiel 14:21]]. Fear the sword over our figurative land — recall the [[flaming sword guarding Eden >> Bible:Genesis 3:24]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Double torment of the burning blade
english: A glowing blade cuts and burns at once. Pray we never must pass under it. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
